inference

attention

topics.title: Linear → DeltaNet
label: Linear
→ DeltaNet

topics.title: Kimi Delta Attention
label: Kimi Delta
Attention

topics.description: Full educational KDA with recurrent and convolution caches, low-rank projections, per-head rates, and a tested chunkwise worked example.
topics.scope: The recurrent layer is learner-written. Chunkwise code and learning visuals are explicitly AI-authored.

topics.title: Latent attention
label: Latent
attention
topics.caption: MLA · exploratory implementation
topics.description: Explore compressed KV states, decoupled RoPE dimensions, and inference weight absorption.
topics.scope: Work in progress: public API, correctness/cache tests, and absorbed-path verification are not complete.

topics.title: Long-context RoPE
label: Long-context
RoPE / YaRN
topics.caption: Interpolation vs. extrapolation
topics.description: Study RoPE extension, frequency-dependent scaling, YaRN, and the effect on original and extended context lengths.

topics.title: FlashAttention
label: Flash
Attention
topics.caption: Theory done · code deferred
topics.description: Online softmax and tiled attention reasoning are documented. The plain-PyTorch implementation remains intentionally deferred.
topics.scope: Theory complete is not the same as implementation complete.

topics.title: Mixture of Experts
label: Mixture
of Experts
topics.caption: Route · dispatch · combine
topics.description: Naive, batched and grouped experts; capacity, diagnostics, auxiliary/z losses, shared experts, and bias-based balancing.
topics.scope: All 14 MoE stages are complete for educational scope, not a production-model reproduction.

topics.title: Expert parallelism
label: Expert
parallelism
topics.caption: All-to-all · forward / backward
topics.description: Two-rank CPU/Gloo dispatch and return, with output/gradient parity and empty-rank regression tests.
topics.scope: The separate commented backward example is AI-authored teaching code. No full distributed decoder trainer or multi-GPU speedup is claimed.

topics.title: LatentMoE & balancing
label: LatentMoE
& balancing
topics.caption: SiTU-GLU · exact / histogram QB
topics.description: Latent routed projections, post-combination normalization, SiTU-GLU, quantile bias updates, local training integration, and distributed histogram pooling.
topics.scope: Latent/SiTU decoder forwarding, distributed exact gathering, and full distributed runner integration remain optional extensions.

topics.title: Profiling & memory
label: Profiling
& memory
topics.caption: Decoder FLOPs · HBM · step time
topics.description: Profile an entire decoder training step and account for FLOPs, activations, parameters, optimizer state, and cache memory. Begin the CUDA correctness and profiling exercises here.
topics.scope: MoE-specific accounting is already covered; this is the broader decoder-wide exercise.

topics.title: Precision & quantization
label: Precision
& quantization
topics.caption: BF16 / FP16 → INT8 / INT4
topics.description: Establish a BF16 training baseline and exercise loss scaling, accumulation, block-scaled quantization, GPTQ/AWQ concepts, and cache quantization.
topics.scope: Some precision topics appeared in earlier exercises; the dedicated track remains planned.

topics.title: Distributed systems
label: Distributed
systems
topics.caption: DDP · FSDP2 · TP/SP · PP · CP
topics.description: Build native PyTorch data, tensor, sequence, pipeline, and context parallel exercises. Use distributed checkpointing, profile collectives, then compose FSDP2 and TP on a device mesh.

lanes.title: Train & adapt

topics.title: Activation checkpointing
label: Activation
checkpointing
topics.caption: Saved activations vs. recomputation
topics.description: Checkpoint Transformer blocks, preserve dropout RNG behavior, verify output/gradient parity, and measure the memory/runtime tradeoff. Protect MoE metrics and other mutable state from duplicate updates during recomputation.
topics.scope: Training-memory optimization, not model/optimizer checkpoint files. Start after activation accounting and mixed precision, before distributed composition.

topics.title: Training & evaluation
label: Training
& evaluation
topics.caption: Packed data · exact resume · evaluation

topics.title: Fine-tuning
label: Fine
tuning
topics.caption: LoRA · QLoRA · SFT
topics.description: Implement parameter-efficient adaptation, supervised fine-tuning, and the foundations of preference optimization.

topics.title: PPO
label: PPO
topics.caption: Rollouts · advantages · clipping

topics.title: GRPO
label: GRPO
